tvShow.name: Occupation Double
tvShow.overview: Occupation double follows the lives of single girls and boys from Quebec who have one thing in common: the search for love. For several weeks, the girls and boys selected to be part of the adventure live in a dream rental abroad. The candidates live separately in two luxury houses located side by side. Through activities, trips and parties, the singles rub shoulders and get to know each other. Each week, the girls must eliminate a boy, or the boys must eliminate a girl, until there is only one winning couple left.

seasons.name: Season 9
seasons.overview: For its 19th season, Occupation Double is heading to a captivating island in the Mediterranean Sea: Cyprus! Hosting for a third year, Alicia Moffet and Fred Robichaud will guide singles on an intense adventure and witness the comings and goings of… and the heartbreaks! Between the heavenly beaches, the twists and turns and the roller coasters of emotions, the fall promises to be hot and unpredictable thanks to OD Cyprus!
